newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Thursday, as technical selling from local investors capped the topside throughout the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 190 to 240 yen lower, with the benchmark July 1998 contract down 200 yen at 13,740 yen per tonne.
Technical trading dominated the market today, as the CBOT corn market overnight gave no clear direction to local investors, traders said.
Traders said they are watching to see if the benchmark July 1998 falls below the 13,700 yen line.
The spot September corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.46-1/2 per bushel at 0810 GMT, against $2.47-1/4 at Wednesday's close.
The spot August CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.39-1/2 per bushel at 0810 GMT, against $7.39 at Wednesday's close.
